CHANGELOG updated in BRAWLPIT: SERVER_HOST default fixed from 127.0.0.1 to the real public deploy (brawlpit.okemily.com, new DNS A record) -- this was the actual reason multiplayer never worked for anyone off the server's own box. Live-verified with a real external UDP round trip. (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)
